_about: Skill books (user's decisions, see CLAUDE.md SKILL BOOKS). A book holds PAGES; a page goes on ONE skill of one hero for the rest of the run. kind 'stat' = small numbers (max combat.json books.maxStatPages per skill, may repeat): power (% skill damage, heals, shields, buff size), cooldown (% shorter), windup (% shorter), duration (% longer statuses/buffs/shields the skill gives). kind 'modifier' = changes what the skill does (max books.modifierSlots per skill, no duplicates on one skill): ink (statuses put on every enemy the skill hits; a support skill puts them on the enemy nearest the caster), siphon (% of skill damage heals the caster; supportHealPercent of max health for a support skill), selfApply / squadApply (statuses on the caster / whole squad when the skill goes off), plus the same number fields as stat pages (negative = worse) and windupMultiplier. More modifier fields: allyHeal {count, percentMaxHp} + selfCostPercent (Blood Price), tornado (Excalibur tornado spec, Cyclone), ricochet (share for a second target), aftershock {delayMs, power}, grow {scale, durationMs} (Titan look), purify (debuffs cleansed), roar {radius, taunt, self}, summon {minion, max}, onHitChance {chance, apply} (Concussive), desperate {belowPercent, power}, critBonus (Keen), fightStartCharge (% of the cooldown done when a fight starts, Quick Draw), armorPierce (% defense/resist ignored), selfHealPercent (Second Wind), momentum {attacks, damagePercent}, vsLow {belowPercent, power} (Finisher), vsBig {power} (Giant Slayer: elites and bosses), detonate {statuses, perStack (x attack per stack), maxStacks}, chainSpark {jumps, power, damageType}, allyShield (a shield spec on the most hurt hero, Guardian), otherCooldownMs (Tempo), untilFightEnd on a selfApply spec (gone when the next floor starts, Glass Cannon), echo {power} (always echoes), resetOther (Time Warp), executioner {belowPercent, cooldownBackPercent, healPercent (caster, per execute)}, phoenix {hpPercent} (once per floor), elementalStorm {elements, weakBonus (% more when it finds a weakness), weakApply (statuses on an enemy hit with its weakness)}. HERO pages: `hero` + `skill` (fits only that hero's named skill) and `patch` (changes the skill when it goes off; fields in BattleState heroPagePatch).
_tiers: PAGE TIERS (user, session 45): every modifier page has a tier: common, rare, legendary or hero (a hero-only page, `hero` = that hero's id; only offered when that hero is alive in the squad). tierOdds[book] = weights for each modifier page's tier. specials[book] = chances that ONE modifier page of that book is upgraded to a legendary / a hero page (rolled separately, both can happen in one book). An empty tier falls back to the next lower one (hero > legendary > rare > common).
_heroFrame: The card frame of a hero-only page on the reward screen (the other tiers use rarities.json; stat pages the common frame).
_specialsByBoss: THE BOSS PRIZE GROWS (user, session 46): the golden book after the Nth boss uses entry N (the last entry for every later boss) instead of specials.golden. 1st boss: rares only; 2nd: 1 legendary for sure + 5% hero page; 3rd: legendary + 15% hero; 4th and later: legendary + 25% hero.

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.text: +12% skill power (damage, healing, shield or buff size).

lasting.name: Lasting
lasting.text: What the skill gives lasts 15% longer.

venomInk.name: Venom Ink
venomInk.text: Every enemy the skill hits also gets 2 stacks of Poison.

razorInk.name: Razor Ink
razorInk.text: Every enemy the skill hits also gets 2 stacks of Bleed.

emberInk.name: Ember Ink
emberInk.text: Every enemy the skill hits also gets 2 stacks of Burn.

frostInk.name: Frost Ink
frostInk.text: Every enemy the skill hits also gets 2 stacks of Chill.

siphon.name: Siphon
siphon.text: 8% of the damage it deals heals the caster (support skill: heals the caster 3% of max health).

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.text: Casting gives the caster a shield of 8% of its max health for 4s.

rally.name: Rally
rally.text: Casting gives the whole squad +10% attack speed for 3s.

hasty.name: Hasty
hasty.text: Cooldown 25% shorter, but skill power 20% lower.

keen.name: Keen
keen.text: +20% crit chance on the skill's hits.

heavy.name: Heavy
heavy.text: +20% skill power, but the cooldown is 8% longer.

quickDraw.name: Quick Draw
quickDraw.text: Every fight starts with the skill half charged (half its cooldown already done).

piercing.name: Piercing
piercing.text: The skill's hits ignore 30% of the enemy's defense and resist.

secondWind.name: Second Wind
secondWind.text: Casting heals the caster 4% of its max health.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.text: After casting, the caster's next 3 basic attacks deal +20% damage.

finisher.name: Finisher
finisher.text: +40% skill power against enemies under 30% health.

giantSlayer.name: Giant Slayer
giantSlayer.text: +30% skill power against elites and bosses.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.text: +60% skill power, but the wind-up is twice as long.

huntersInk.name: Hunter's Ink
huntersInk.text: Every enemy the skill hits is Marked for 4s (+15% damage taken from everyone).

bloodPrice.name: Blood Price
bloodPrice.text: Also heals the 2 most hurt allies for 8% of their max health, but costs the caster 6% of its health.

shockInk.name: Shock Ink
shockInk.text: Every enemy the skill hits is Shocked for 3s (slower attacks, may fumble).

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.text: Every enemy the skill hits loses 20% of its defense for 5s.

detonate.name: Detonate
detonate.text: Poison, Bleed and Burn stacks on an enemy the skill hits go off at once: a bonus hit per stack, and the stacks are used up.

chainSpark.name: Chain Spark
chainSpark.text: A spark jumps from the enemy hit to 2 more enemies for 30% (electric).

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.text: Casting shields the most hurt ally for 10% of its max health for 4s.

warCry.name: War Cry
warCry.text: Casting gives the whole squad +12% attack for 4s.

tempo.name: Tempo
tempo.text: Casting takes 1.5s off the caster's other skill's cooldown.

glassCannon.name: Glass Cannon
glassCannon.text: +60% skill power, but after casting the caster has 15% less max health until the fight ends.

cyclone.name: Cyclone
cyclone.text: A tornado spins up on the target for 6s and drifts between enemies. Cooldown 15% longer.

ricochet.name: Ricochet
ricochet.text: A one-target skill also hits 1 more enemy at 50% (a heal or buff on one ally also reaches a second ally at 50%).

aftershock.name: Aftershock
aftershock.text: 1 second later a second pulse hits the same targets for 35% (a heal pulses again at 35%).

echo.name: Echo
echo.text: The skill always fires a second time at 60% power (not channels or flasks thrown one by one).

timeWarp.name: Time Warp
timeWarp.text: Casting makes the caster's other skill ready again at once.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.text: A normal enemy (not elite or boss) the skill leaves under 25% health dies, and the caster heals 5% of max health. A kill gives back 50% of the cooldown.

phoenixPage.name: Phoenix Page
phoenixPage.text: Once per floor, a hit that would kill the caster leaves it at 20% health and fires this skill for free.

elementalStorm.name: Elemental Storm
elementalStorm.text: Each hit turns into the element the enemy is weakest to (fire, ice, electric or dark). When it finds a weakness: 30% more damage, and the enemy deals 15% less damage for 3s.

titan.name: Titan
titan.text: The caster grows 30% bigger for 3s: +20% max health and attack, but 10 less evasion.

shockwave.name: Shockwave
shockwave.text: Defense Bash's stun also hits the enemies next to its target.

earthshaker.name: Earthshaker
earthshaker.text: Savage Leap stuns its target and every enemy hit by the landing for 1.5s.

downpour.name: Downpour
downpour.text: Arrow Rain falls for 2 more waves.

twinCrescent.name: Twin Crescent
twinCrescent.text: Wind Cutter also slashes the row of enemies behind.

convergence.name: Convergence
convergence.text: Every 3rd Elemental Rotation cast also fires the other two spells.

radiance.name: Radiance
radiance.text: Holy Nova heals the 2 most hurt allies instead of one.

boneHarvest.name: Bone Harvest
boneHarvest.text: A Death Coil kill raises 3 skeletons instead of one.

bigBatch.name: Big Batch
bigBatch.text: Flask Barrage throws 9 flasks instead of 5.

purify.name: Purify
purify.text: Casting removes 1 debuff from the caster (a support skill cleans every ally it touches instead).

roar.name: Roar
roar.text: Enemies near the caster are Taunted for 2s and the caster gets +10 defense for 2s. The caster takes those hits.

gravecall.name: Gravecall
gravecall.text: Raises 1 weak skeleton next to the caster that fights until the floor ends. At most 2 page skeletons per hero.

concussive.name: Concussive
concussive.text: Each hit has a 20% chance to Stun for 0.6s (bosses: half as long). Cooldown 15% longer.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.text: +45% skill power, but for 4s after casting the caster takes 15% more damage.

desperate.name: Desperate
desperate.text: +75% skill power while the caster is under 40% health.

blue.name: Skill Book
blue.description: Choose 1 of 3 pages and put it on one hero's skill for the rest of the run.

golden.name: Golden Skill Book
golden.description: A boss's prize: choose 1 of 3 modifier pages for one hero's skill.

dealer.name: Skill Dealer
dealer.description: Choose 1 of 3 pages and put it on one hero's skill for the rest of the run.
